downloadApp.dialogSubtitle: Official guide to installing the Booyah Win APK safely
downloadApp.step1Desc: Tap "Download App". If your browser displays "File might be harmful", tap "Download anyway". This is a standard Android prompt for apps downloaded outside Google Play.
downloadApp.step2Desc: Open the downloaded file from your notifications or Downloads folder. If prompted, tap "Settings" and enable "Allow from this source", then return and tap "Install".
downloadApp.step3Desc: If Google Play Protect warns that the app is unrecognized, tap "More details" followed by "Install anyway". Our APK is 100% verified, virus-free, and safe.
downloadApp.safetyWarningDesc: The APK file should come ONLY from this official site. Never download or accept Booyah Win APK files from third-party links, Telegram, or WhatsApp.
